pages.text: $(li)$(thing)Cool-season:$() sow as soon as the ground thaws. Sprouts after 100 °C·d above 0 °C.$(li)Ripens after $(thing)1500 °C·d$(). Best near 22 °C; stops above 35 °C.$(li)$(thing)Frost$() kills it below -12 °C (-2 °C in flower).

$(li)$(thing)Soil pH$() 6-7.5 (tolerates 5.2-8.5). Roots 1.5 m. Some tolerance of wet soil.$(li)$(thing)Feeds on$() N 105, P 18, K 80 kg/ha per crop.$(li)$(thing)Yield$() when well grown: about 52 bu/ac (3.5 t/ha).$(li)$(thing)Harvest:$() Wheat and Wheat Seeds.
